SUEQ.description: Scale-Up Factors of Earthquake Load (SUEQ). Per-key scale factors applied to earthquake load results, split by source (load case vs load combination) and force component. To use any /DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/* endpoint, first activate the AIJ-ASD02 design code with PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. Note: PUT fully replaces the record; every omitted field is written with its default 1.0, not preserved. DELETE removes the entry.

LCOM_AXIAL.description: Load Combination - Axial force scale factor.
